notes.zh:
回答「Microsoft 自研推理芯片到哪一代、规格和部署状态如何」。Maia 200 是微软第二代自研 AI 加速器，TSMC 3nm、216GB HBM3e / 7TB/s、272MB 片上 SRAM、原生 FP8/FP4，单芯片 FP4 超过 10 PFLOPS、FP8 超过 5 PFLOPS，750W SoC；2.8TB/s 双向 scale-up，官方称可连 6,144 颗。已部署在 US Central，US West 3 随后。
不主张：Maia 200 不对外以 Azure VM 形式出租，Azure 客户是通过 Microsoft 365 Copilot、Foundry 等服务间接用到；30% 每美元性能是微软对自家 fleet 的口径，不是跨厂商横评；没有公开价格；10 PF 是 FP4，不是所有精度；6,144 是 scale-up 集群上限，不是单机架。
notes.en:
Answers which generation Microsoft's in-house inference chip has reached, its specs and deployment state. Maia 200 is Microsoft's second-generation custom AI accelerator: TSMC 3nm, 216 GB HBM3e at 7 TB/s, 272 MB on-chip SRAM, native FP8/FP4, over 10 PFLOPS FP4 and over 5 PFLOPS FP8 within a 750 W SoC, plus 2.8 TB/s bidirectional scale-up and clusters of up to 6,144 accelerators. It is deployed in US Central, with US West 3 next.
It does not claim: Maia 200 is not rented as an Azure VM; Azure customers reach it through services such as Microsoft 365 Copilot and Foundry. The 30% performance-per-dollar figure is Microsoft's comparison against its own fleet, not a cross-vendor benchmark; no public price; 10 PF is FP4, not every precision; 6,144 is a scale-up cluster ceiling, not a single rack.

specs.部署 / deployment: US Central 已部署；US West 3 随后
